newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates rise to 21.875 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates rise to 21.875 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates rose to close at 21.875 percent on Monday in a balanced market, traders said.
Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank said overnight rates traded in a narrow range between 21.50 and 22 percent and the rise was natural on the first day of the banks' two-week reserve period.

Delayed mid-month tax payments were cause for minor uncertainty Tuesday, but were unlikely to have a significant impact on the rates, he said. Expectations of a repo rate cut by the central bank could tighten liquidity, Tolonics added.

The central bank's overnight and one-week repo rates stand at 27.50 percent, the overnight reverse repo at 17.50 percent, the one-week reverse repo at 21.50 percent and the one-month reverse repo at 22 percent.
